'''2011 German National Championship Thorsten Schelian LS Heading For The Medical Frigate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thorsten Schelian]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
